name: Periapt of Wound Closure

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: You stabilize at the start of your turn when dying, and Hit Point Dice you spend heal twice as much.
text: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. In addition, whenever you roll a Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points it restores.
